integrity: The theorem concerns the exact coefficient-marked genus-four family in characteristic eleven. The polynomial identities, discriminant test, Kummer irreducibility, and Frobenius-product calculations are reproducible from accompanying source files. No assertion of complete geometric isomorphism classification or independent validation is made.
limitations: The twenty-five exceptional objects are distinct marked parameter values, not necessarily twenty-five distinct geometric isomorphism classes.
No inference of supersingularity is made from p-rank zero.
Full text of Sohn (2025) was not accessible during the related-literature comparison; possible coverage is a residual priority risk.
title: Twenty-five rank-zero fibers in a characteristic-eleven genus-four cyclic trigonal pencil
